exposure: preoperative vaginal preparation with 1% povidone iodine
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) were recruited and divided into two groups based on whether they received preoperative vaginal povidone-iodine preparation.
finding: The incidence of post-caesarean endometritis and fever was significantly lower in women who received preoperative vaginal povidone-iodine compared to controls.
mod_finding: Preoperative vaginal povidone-iodine application significantly reduces post-caesarean section endometritis and fever, thereby reducing caesarean-related morbidity.
